title: Beyond Empirical Support: Structured Outlier Generation via Sinkhorn Optimal Transport
summary: Outliers are essential for evaluating and improving the robustness of machine learning systems, especially when future distributions may differ significantly from historical training data. In high-stakes applications, robustness often depends on rare cases that finite datasets fail to capture, making simple resampling or perturbation insufficient for stress scenario generation.
